For each of the three edge orbits, grounding the graph Laplacian yields the claimed entire absolute transfer-current column and the complementary diagonal correction; symmetry reduces the maximum to those three orbit sums. The Green threshold g_j>1/[h(h+n)] occupies 2 log(n)/log(1/rho)+O(1) indices, giving S=2/h-4 log(n)/(h log(1/rho)n)+O(1/n). Distinct limiting maximizers for h>=3 and the h=2 leading-order tie resolved by logarithmic correction prove all asymptotics. Independent exact-rational Laplacian computations replayed all edge columns for (h,n)=(2,4),(3,5),(4,4),(2,7), without inferring the infinite result from the finite tests.
